{"id":"TIE-304","uuid":"96303fae-3855-4acf-9243-e4d7be7888cc","title":"Build the adaptive conversion page for desktop, mobile and foldables","description":"## Problem

The web app needs a focused entry point wired to the tested engine.

## Scope

* Implement labeled multiline input, examples, Convert, Clear and result region.
* Wire request/cancellation state to F10; preserve editable input with results.
* Support mobile keyboards and a documented keyboard shortcut without stealing normal textarea Enter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Paste/type → Convert renders real engine results on phone and desktop.
- [X] Clear/reconvert handles pending work consistently and no stale results appear.
- [ ] Layout works at 320 CSS pixels and 200% zoom with long input.

## Delivery

* Priority: High
* Relative complexity: M (S = small, M = medium; not a time commitment)
* Dependencies: [TIE-293](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-293/create-the-typescript-web-scaffold-with-bun-and-mise>), [TIE-303](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-303/design-the-minimal-paste-convert-copy-interface>), [TIE-301](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-301/build-a-cancellable-local-conversion-pipeline-with-input-limits>)

## Repository evidence

* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainScreen.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainScreen.kt>)
* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainViewModel.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainViewModel.kt>)
* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainUiState.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainUiState.kt>)

## Execution update — 3 October 2026

Responsive form/results, real worker wiring, examples and keyboard shortcut are implemented; 320px and automated light/dark accessibility checks pass. Manual 200% browser zoom/task acceptance remains with U7.

Implementation and detailed evidence: <pull-request id="850e1775-4f2b-4f42-b3ed-5749c0b4347e" href="https://linear.app/tienlam/review/add-simple-offline-web-preview-and-migration-roadmap-c6d7f819269d">Tien-Lam/ChronoShift#16</pull-request>, [execution report](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/codex/offline-web-migration/docs/planning/web-execution-report.md>). The branch is implemented/tested and awaiting review; real-device/release gates remain open where noted.

## Adaptive-device requirement — 4 October 2026

The user explicitly requests desktop, mobile and foldable support. Implement fluid/container-based reflow, safe-area padding, readable landscape layouts, touch-sized controls, preserved input/results during resize and progressive hinge avoidance through CSS viewport segments. Automate 280–1920 CSS-pixel viewports, short/landscape windows and Chromium hinge emulation. Physical folding, virtual-keyboard and device accessibility validation remain release checks.

## Implementation evidence

Fluid/container reflow, 16px form fields, coarse-pointer controls, display safe areas and short-landscape layouts are implemented. Ten viewport sizes (280–1920 CSS pixels) preserve draft/results in each of five browser profiles. Three additional Chromium scenarios verify vertical-hinge panel bounds, upper-screen tabletop scrolling and notch/home-indicator insets. All pass locally, alongside the existing conversion/offline checks (68 browser scenarios total, plus the repository-subpath scenario). Hinge APIs are progressive enhancement; physical-device and actual browser-zoom acceptance remain open. See PR #16 and e2e/responsive.spec.ts / e2e/foldable.spec.ts.

## Direct browser side-panel evidence — 4 October 2026

Direct side-panel production check: real worker conversion and recovery work at desktop and mobile-sized CSS viewports. Seven widths (280, 320, 390, 640, 768, 1280, 1920) preserve an active draft and both CST interpretations; scrollWidth equals clientWidth at every size. A 10,000-character message converts and Clear resets input/result. Ordinary Enter adds a newline; Cmd+Enter converts. Both designs and dark/light themes were visually inspected. The existing regression gate covers pending/canceled work. Actual 200% browser zoom was attempted but not supported by this side panel; it is not claimed as passed. [Evidence](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/main/docs/qa/browser-2026-10-04/README.md>).

## Glass Command release evidence — 4 October 2026

Verified modern Glass Command desktop columns at 1280×900 and stacked Dark/Light at 320px, with 10,000-character input and correct event at its end. The 118-scenario gate covers resize/folding and state retention. Remaining: real phone paste/type → Convert, and actual 200% browser zoom with long input.

{"id":"TIE-306","uuid":"25f15b7c-a663-4319-82bd-93eb30c78f11","title":"Add device timezone default and a searchable target timezone override","description":"## Problem

The Android app converts only to the device timezone; web users need an easy visible default and correction.

## Scope

* Detect the device IANA timezone with a safe explicit fallback.
* Provide a searchable city/IANA zone selector and minimal locale/12–24-hour preference.
* Apply target-zone changes immediately to existing results; use explicit controls to correct source-zone or reference-date assumptions without overwriting explicit parsed values.

## Acceptance criteria

- [X] Default zone is visible, unknown detection leads to a usable selector, and device-zone changes are handled.
- [ ] Selector works offline with keyboard/screen reader and includes supported city aliases.
- [X] Changing target zone changes formatting/conversion without reparsing or losing source interpretations.

## Delivery

* Priority: High
* Relative complexity: M (S = small, M = medium; not a time commitment)
* Dependencies: [TIE-304](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-304/build-the-responsive-conversion-page-and-request-state>), [TIE-295](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-295/implement-a-browser-timezone-adapter-with-explicit-dst-semantics>), [TIE-299](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-299/port-unix-seconds-and-a-deterministic-offline-city-resolver>)

## Repository evidence

* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/conversion/TimeConverter.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/conversion/TimeConverter.kt>)
* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/nlp/CityResolver.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/nlp/CityResolver.kt>)
* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt>)

## Execution update — 3 October 2026

Device Auto target/source, offline city/IANA datalist, reference-date/numeric-date corrections and 12/24-hour display implemented. Target changes reformat existing results without reparsing. Manual assistive-technology confirmation remains U7.

Implementation and detailed evidence: <pull-request id="850e1775-4f2b-4f42-b3ed-5749c0b4347e" href="https://linear.app/tienlam/review/add-simple-offline-web-preview-and-migration-roadmap-c6d7f819269d">Tien-Lam/ChronoShift#16</pull-request>, [execution report](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/codex/offline-web-migration/docs/planning/web-execution-report.md>). The branch is implemented/tested and awaiting review; real-device/release gates remain open where noted.

## Merged implementation; remaining screen-reader acceptance

PR #16 is merged after independent adversarial/code approval and the passing 108-unit/113-browser/subpath gate. Device defaults, alias selector, offline keyboard interaction and interpretation-preserving target changes are implemented. Keep this issue In Progress because its explicit screen-reader acceptance still needs the actual task check tracked with <issue id="105b7272-552b-4157-8a17-f33890930d8e" href="https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-309/verify-accessibility-and-first-time-task-completion">TIE-309</issue>; accessible roles/automated checks are supplementary evidence. [Acceptance matrix](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/main/docs/planning/web-acceptance.md>).

## Direct browser side-panel evidence — 4 October 2026

Actual keyboard traversal reaches the target selector; entering London/Tokyo resolves city aliases and immediately reformats both CST interpretations, including Tokyo date rollover. Accessible combobox labels and live result status appear in the browser accessibility tree. Offline behavior remains covered by the production automated gate; no screen-reader task or disconnected side-panel session is claimed. [Evidence](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/main/docs/qa/browser-2026-10-04/README.md>).

## Glass Command release evidence — 4 October 2026

Single-layout theme migration retains target-zone preferences; the 118-scenario gate retains keyboard/offline/city-alias selector checks. Remaining: actual screen-reader operation of the selector while offline, including supported city aliases.

{"id":"TIE-309","uuid":"105b7272-552b-4157-8a17-f33890930d8e","title":"Verify accessibility and first-time task completion","description":"## Problem

Simple use needs observable keyboard, screen reader and mobile evidence.

## Scope

* Check WCAG 2.2 AA-relevant contrast, focus order, labels, announcements, touch targets, reduced motion and system light/dark.
* Run automated checks plus manual keyboard/screen-reader and mobile review.
* Run a small task-based check: paste meeting text, choose a CST interpretation, change target timezone, copy and reopen offline; document evidence and fix blocking friction.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All core tasks work with keyboard alone and a screen reader; results/errors are announced once appropriately.
- [ ] 320px, 200% zoom, long text and reduced-motion states remain usable.
- [ ] Task-check findings and resolved issues are recorded; no critical accessibility or discoverability defect remains.

## Delivery

* Priority: High
* Relative complexity: M (S = small, M = medium; not a time commitment)
* Dependencies: [TIE-306](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-306/add-device-timezone-default-and-a-searchable-target-timezone-override>), [TIE-307](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-307/implement-user-triggered-paste-and-copy-with-permission-fallbacks>), [TIE-308](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-308/add-helpful-no-result-correction-and-large-input-recovery-states>)

* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainScreen.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/main/MainScreen.kt>)
* [app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/theme/Theme.kt](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/java/com/chronoshift/ui/theme/Theme.kt>)

## Execution update — 3 October 2026

Automated light/dark WCAG checks, labels, keyboard shortcut/newline behavior, 320px and reduced-motion review pass. Manual screen-reader, 200% zoom and first-time task checks remain.

Implementation and detailed evidence: <pull-request id="850e1775-4f2b-4f42-b3ed-5749c0b4347e" href="https://linear.app/tienlam/review/add-simple-offline-web-preview-and-migration-roadmap-c6d7f819269d">Tien-Lam/ChronoShift#16</pull-request>, [execution report](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/codex/offline-web-migration/docs/planning/web-execution-report.md>). ## Direct browser side-panel evidence — 4 October 2026

Actual side-panel task review covers Tab/Enter navigation, Cmd+Enter, ordinary textarea newline, CST interpretation-specific copy, changing target, 12-hour display, DST-gap correction, no-result guidance and Clear after a maximum-length conversion. 320px and six other CSS viewport sizes preserve the flow without horizontal overflow. No blocking friction was observed in those tasks. AX snapshots provide semantic evidence; actual screen-reader and 200% zoom criteria remain unverified because the exposed browser controls cannot exercise them. [Evidence and screenshots](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/main/docs/qa/browser-2026-10-04/README.md>).

## Glass Command release evidence — 4 October 2026

Remaining: actual screen-reader journey and appropriate single announcements, real 200% browser zoom with long input, and corresponding task friction/defect assessment.

{"id":"TIE-311","uuid":"f4a3814b-334f-4347-b0f4-e5d0ff2e5114","title":"Add a PWA manifest and unobtrusive install guidance","description":"## Problem

Users should be able to keep the converter on a home screen or desktop without making installation mandatory.

## Scope

* Provide name, icons, stable app ID, start URL/scope, standalone display and theme metadata.
* Capability-detect install prompting and provide browser-specific manual guidance where appropriate.
* Test normal browser and installed modes on Android, iOS and desktop.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Manifest/start URL/icon validation passes and installed launch reaches the converter offline.
- [X] Install guidance appears only when relevant and can be dismissed.
- [X] Unsupported installation does not remove normal browser conversion or show a dead button.

## Delivery

* Priority: Medium
* Relative complexity: S (S = small, M = medium; not a time commitment)
* Dependencies: [TIE-310](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-310/precache-the-complete-app-and-verify-offline-readiness>), [TIE-304](<https://linear.app/tienlam/issue/TIE-304/build-the-responsive-conversion-page-and-request-state>)

## Repository evidence

* [app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml>)
* [app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml](<https://github.com/Tien-Lam/ChronoShift/blob/b7ef48a/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml>)
